ValidationRule.description: Salary must sit in a grade band (CASE), bonus cannot exceed a log-scaled share of salary, and part-timers' salaries are scaled by weekly hours.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Salary__c)), OR( Salary__c < CASE(TEXT(Grade__c), 'Junior', 40000, 'Mid', 65000, 'Senior', 90000, 'Staff', 120000, 'Principal', 150000, 'Director', 180000, 0) * IF(ISPICKVAL(Employment_Type__c, 'Part Time'), MIN(1, NULLVALUE(Weekly_Hours__c, 40) / 40), 1), Salary__c > CASE(TEXT(Grade__c), 'Junior', 90000, 'Mid', 130000, 'Senior', 190000, 'Staff', 260000, 'Principal', 350000, 'Director', 600000, 10000000), NULLVALUE(Bonus__c, 0) > Salary__c * ROUND(LN(Salary__c) / 40, 2) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Salary or bonus is outside the band for the grade.
